finding.text: ext/highlight's docs are now stale: `readme.md` still says "Unregistered languages (`bash`, `diff`) render as escaped plain text" and lists `code.html / css / md / json` without `code.sh`; `page.js` (lines 14-21, the Languages section) names five grammar files and five accessors; `doc/choice.md` "Keep: five languages" and `doc/decisions.md` line 138 (open item "More languages: bash and diff") don't mention that bash has landed. Update all four in the same commit (documentation rule, Law 9).
`public/live/LiveCode.test.mjs` is not indexed: `public/live/readme.md` line 50 lists only `LivePage.test.mjs` under "Tests:". Add it there (Law 10).

Ask 1's "a long line scrolls inside the block" is claimed, not shown: none of the three demo cards has a line longer than the block, so the shots prove only `overflow_x false` at 400 (layout.json), not the scroll. The css card's caption says it does; one long line in the js card would prove it.

The card title (`h4.live-card-title`) draws almost as large as the page h1 (shots/…code-card/1200.png: "A sum" vs "Page features"), so three cards read as three sections. That size comes from LivePage's existing `.live-card-title`, not this diff.
Two `item.on("change")` listeners (one per key, `LiveCode.js:24`) where one listener checking `k === "lang" || k === "code"` would do. Harmless.
